title: Design System: LendFlow — The Safelight Bay

display.purpose: Door headlines and view titles — Barlow bold, tight leading.

headline.purpose: Panel-view page titles (Record a payment, Issue a loan).

title.purpose: Panel and section titles inside the room.

body.purpose: Prose, descriptions, table cells; silver on dark, ink on paper.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, figure captions — mono uppercase wide-tracked.

figure.purpose: All money, IDs, dates, percentages — IBM Plex Mono tabular numerals, bold.

hand.purpose: Caveat annotations only — insights, encouragement; never data.

shadows.name: print-drop
shadows.purpose: Drying-line prints — paper hanging off the line.

shadows.name: statement-sheet
shadows.purpose: The full statement modal — heaviest paper in the room.

shadows.name: thumb-drop
shadows.purpose: Row-level print thumbnails, with inset ink ring.

shadows.name: rope-cast
shadows.purpose: The drying line casting onto the wall.

motion.name: ease-develop
motion.purpose: Default easing for the develop reveal and most state transitions.

motion.name: develop-reveal
motion.value: opacity .25→1; blur(7px)→0; brightness(.45)→1; contrast(.7)→1; translateY(6px)→0; ~1s, staggered 70–120ms
motion.purpose: Signature entrance — content emerges like a print in the developer bath.

motion.name: fix-flash
motion.purpose: One-shot confirmation pulse when money is fixed in the ledger.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables .dev and .pulse-fix; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: The room is still for visitors who need it still.

narrative.overview:
LendFlow's redesign is a printing darkroom under amber safelight. The room is dark — deep bay blacks washed with an amber glow from above — and every loan is a photographic print developing through fixed, irreversible stations: received → issued → active → due → paid. A loan emerges from blur toward fixed at exactly the rate it's repaid; a fully paid loan is "fixed", and a pending loan sits "in the bath". Chrome is darkroom enamel; content is photographic paper. Money figures are wet-print silver or segmented timer digits; working notes are grease-pencil. The system refuses the category default of white cards on gray with a KPI-hero row: figures live in a ruled statement-header strip inline, never as cards.

The room must always answer the operator's question — where does each print stand — without a single color-only signal. Every status is a stamp: named, bordered, and colored at once. Density stays honest (this is a working bay, not a showroom), but the atmosphere carries trust: nothing hides in this light.
keyCharacteristics: Amber safelight wash over layered darkroom-dark bays; photographic paper appears only as content artifacts (print cards, statement, toast).
All money figures and IDs in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals; Barlow carries UI and prose.
Status grammar = stamps: every state named AND marked AND colored; dashed borders mark provisional states.
The develop reveal: content enters with a blur/brightness/contrast emergence, staggered, honoring reduced motion.
Print thumbnails whose blur/brightness map to % repaid; the borrower's loans hang on a rope/clip drying line.
Grease-pencil (Caveat) reserved strictly for annotations — never data, never UI copy.

rules.name: The One Safelight Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only room light. It appears on ≤10% of any screen — actions, the active station, the day's figures. If everything glows, nothing develops.

rules.name: The Named, Marked, Colored Rule
rules.body: Every status exists as a stamp carrying a text name, a 2px border, and a color simultaneously. Color is never the sole signal of any state.

rules.name: The Dark-Room, Paper-Content Rule
rules.body: Darkroom chrome (bays, rails, panels) never carries long-form reading on white; papergrain surfaces never sit on the dark side of a border-line. Ink on paper, silver on bay — never mixed.

rules.name: The Monospace Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every money amount, ID, percentage, date, and tabular figure is IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums. No exception in tables, stamps, or readouts.

rules.name: The Grease-Pencil Rule
rules.body: Caveat marks working notes and encouragement only. It never sets data, statuses, buttons, or anything a borrower must transcribe exactly.

rules.name: The Physical-Paper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are cast only by paper artifacts — prints, statement, toast, thumbnails, rope. Panels, rails, and buttons are flat enamel; they separate by tone and border, never shadow.

dos: Do set every money figure, ID, date, and percentage in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums (.tnum).

Do mark every loan status with a stamp that names it, borders it, and colors it — Paid · fixed (green, −3°), Overdue (dashed red, +2°), In the bath (dashed silver), Defaulted (red fill), Active (amber).
Do keep chrome dark (bay/bay2/tray) and put long-form or readable content only on papergrain surfaces (#f6efe2).
Do reserve amber (#ffb224) for primary actions, the active station, focus, selection, and today's-due emphasis; use developed amber (#b97a15) for amber hardware on paper.

Do enter content with the develop reveal (blur 7px → 0, brightness .45 → 1, contrast .7 → 1, translateY 6px → 0, ~1s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1), staggered 70–120ms) and disable it under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do map print-thumbnail emergence to % repaid — the visual is the data.
Do use dashed borders for provisional states (pending, likely-match inbox items, scan placeholder, empty states).
donts: Don't build KPI cards; money figures live in the ruled statement-header strip, inline.
Don't signal any state with color alone — always name + mark + color.
Don't use Caveat for data, statuses, buttons, or anything needing exact transcription.
Don't shadow flat enamel panels, rails, or buttons; shadows belong only to paper artifacts and the rope.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; the room has one safelight. Fog red and fixed green are service grammar, not decoration.
Don't use the segmented timer voice for anything but the day's batch.
Don't fabricate real borrower data or drop the "sample data only" disclosure on entry surfaces.
